label: goal and limit: -kade, paryant
note: MARATHI-SPECIFIC, and now half closed. -kade is taught (chapter 48) and carries possession, direction and 'at somebody's place' on its own. paryant is not, and it is the reason this point stays open: writing it needs the REPH of MR-A1-OR-21, which no lesson teaches, so the two debts are the same debt. Half a pair is not this point.
